'''Tessek''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the water planet of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. He once had ties with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] politics, but when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] invaded his home planet, he fled and became a member of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] court. While serving as the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] accountant, Tessek planned to kill his master by planting a bomb on [[Khetanna/Legends|his sail barge]]. Tessek survived the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] after escaping on a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]&mdash;however, when he returned to Jabba's Palace, his brain was forcibly removed from his body by the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Monks]].

==Biography==
[[File:TessekEGC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tessek]]{{Quote|I know that you plot Jabba's demise, but you fear that your own henchmen-Ree-Yees, Barada, and the Weequays-are too inept and untrustworthy to carry out your plots.|A B'omarr Monk to Tessek|<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Tessek" /> [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] leader<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Tessek}}</ref> with ties to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] politics,<ref name="Tessek" /> Tessek fled [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began taking both Quarren and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] as slaves. Tessek eventually ended up on Tatooine, a planet unsuited to the Quarren skin type, causing him to have to lie in a bath for much of the day.<ref name="EGC" /> Tessek eventually found work as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] accountant. After his conscience began to bother him, Tessek formulated a plot to assassinate Jabba. He collaborated with the Empire to have Jabba killed, and the sly Quarren employed [[Barada/Legends|Barada]], [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]], and some [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] as agents. After Jabba was dead, Tessek planned to sell his criminal empire to [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], while keeping the legitimate side of Jabba's empire for himself.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" /> However, those closest to Jabba knew of Tessek's betrayal and informed the Hutt, who quickly began to distrust the Quarren.<ref name="EGC" />

To protect his credits, and some of Jabba's wealth as well, Tessek hid huge amounts of funds in key locations throughout the Tatooine desert. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], one of these buried safe boxes was compromised when creatures built their lair near Tessek's treasure trove, preventing him from retrieving his money. To correct the problem, he was forced to hire a well-armed individual to exterminate the creatures and retrieve the safe box.<ref name="SWG:BT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Buried Treasure}} on Tatooine</ref>

Tessek made a deal with [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Eugene Talmont]] to get Jabba to go to a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] deal that would be raided by Talmont. However, Tessek paid two of Talmont's junior officers to fire at both the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] and their own superior. Tessek also had Barada, Jabba's chief mechanic, plant a bomb on Jabba's sail barge, which was large enough to destroy Jabba, Talmont, and the entire warehouse.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />

The morning of the spice deal, Tessek was visited in his private chamber by an enlightened B'omarr Monk, who predicted that if the Quarren's plan succeeded, he would become a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of wealth, and would be plotted against by beings similar to himself. The monk also told Tessek that Jabba was fully aware of his accountant's disloyalty, through the spying of [[Salacious B. Crumb/Legends|Salacious B. Crumb]] and [[Ortugg]]. Then the spider-like droid invited Tessek to join the B'omarr, and become enlightened. Tessek declined the offer, and shot the droid with a concealed [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />

===A Jedi arrival===
[[File:Tessek-Reeyees-Tiel-SailBarge-ROTJ.png|thumb|318x318px|Tessek alongside Ree-Yees on the ''Khetanna'']]
Tessek's plans became more complicated when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], demanding that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] be set free. The Hutt refused, and sent the young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor's]] pit. Unlike most of the beings who went down there, Skywalker survived, killing the beast. A furious Jabba then ordered that the prisoners be taken to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|sarlacc pit]] immediately. When Tessek became reluctant to go, Jabba's suspicions were raised. He demanded that Tessek stay at his side at all times.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />

Desperate, Tessek pleaded with [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]], Jabba's closest friend, to ask Jabba to release Skywalker. Tessek feigned interest in the Hutt's safety, while actually he just wanted the Hutt to go to the spice deal. Despite Mon's efforts, Jabba insisted that Skywalker and friends were to be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]].<ref name="Old Friends">{{StoryCite|story=Old Friends: Ephant Mon's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

As he passed through Jabba's throne room on his way to the palace's [[motor pool]], he noticed [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]] reach into a secret compartment of Jabba's throne, taking small gems and stuffing them into her [[clothing]]. Caught in the middle of the act, she paused and pleaded with Tessek in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. Tessek halted, considering turning her in to appear more friendly with Jabba. Instead, he shrugged the ordeal off and proceeded to the motor pool.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />

Tessek hid a swoop bike on his master's sail barge just before it departed, as he did not intend to be present when his bomb was detonated. As the huge sail barge traveled to the Great Pit of Carkoon, Tessek became more and more visibly dehydrated: his skin itched and cracked in spots, and his normal gray skin blanched to white.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />

When the barge finally reached their destination, Tessek was extremely worried&mdash;the expected phalanx of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fighters had yet to arrive, and the execution had already begun. With a miniature battle taking place aboard Jabba's skiffs, Tessek took aim at his master, but with Leia Organa in the way, he didn't shoot, leaving the young princess to murder the Hutt. Tessek also foiled an attempt from a Weequay, one of his henchmen, to kill Leia, shooting him in the neck. Tessek escaped just in time to see his master's sail barge explode.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />

Shortly thereafter, Tessek returned to the palace, and was forcibly recruited by the B'omarr Monks and had his brain removed from his body. After a short time adjusting to his [[B'omarr brain walker|new body]], Tessek liked to climb atop the towers in Jabba's Palace,<ref name="Tessek's Tale" /> becoming friendly with [[Buboicullaar/Legends|Buboicullaar]] and [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], who had both joined the ranks of the B'omarr. At one point he even sent a telepathic message to the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] telling them "''If you ever return to Jabba's fortress you will find a free Quarren in the Palace''"<ref name="Epilogue: Whatever Became Of...?">{{StoryCite|story=Epilogue: Whatever Became Of...?|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Tessek was a scheming individual, who would betray as many people as possible to ensure a profit. The Quarren accountant was always nervous, worrying about what Jabba might do to him if he discovered his treachery. Tessek also disliked most of the other regulars in Jabba's Palace, especially Ree-Yees, whom Tessek had to forcibly remind not to reveal his plans to everyone.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" /> The two also often fought.<ref name="EGC" />

Although he both hated and feared the B'omarr Monks, they had sensed his desire for freedom and on the morning before Jabba's death, offered to help Tessek obtain it. Fully aware of what that offer required, the Quarren refused. However, after his brain was forcibly removed and placed in a brain jar, Tessek did indeed find the peace and freedom he desired just as the monks had promised, and ultimately, he was happier than he had ever been when he was in his body.<ref name="Tessek's Tale" />

Tessek had [[Color/Legends|turquoise-colored]] eyes, salmon-colored skin,<ref name="Tessek" /> suction-tipped [[Limb|finger]]<nowiki/>s, and manipulative [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] [[Limb|tentacle]]<nowiki/>s.<ref name="CharEnc" />

==Equipment==
While at Jabba's palace, he wore a moisture-retaining [[Robe/Legends|robe]],<ref name="CharEnc" /> a [[Vand belt/Legends|Vand belt]], and a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]].<ref name="SWVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> He also utilized a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|holdout blaster]], and a [[Sonic grenade/Legends|sonic grenade]].<ref name="Tessek" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Tessek was played by the actor/mime artist [[Gerald Home]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] but went uncredited.

In the rough draft of the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] script, [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] was named Tessek. As that was the version used by [[James Luceno]] for the Episode II references he put into ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', the Tessek that appears in that book is presumably now Tikkes. The name Tessek was also used instead of Tikkes in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization of Episode II]].
